title: A check-in node created after signing shipped accepted a bare /n/<id> with no code until the grace window ends
detail:
FOUND 2026-10-05 in the scan-six read of LIVE-688 (95dd410, ADR-1654). LIVE-688 stopped writing a random `nodes.secret` on new check-in nodes (insertCheckinNode) and on /admin/qr nodes, and nodeCodeVerdict answers `legacy` for a node with no secret and NO presented code until LEGACY_NODE_CODE_GRACE_ENDS (2026-12-01). So every node created after the deploy took a bare `/n/<id>` (strip `?s=`) as a valid check-in for two months: a member who scanned once could check in from home for every later event. That is a regression from before LIVE-688, when check-in nodes always carried a secret.

MEASURED ON PROD 2026-10-05: 4 nodes, all created before LIVE-688 and all carrying a secret, so no node was exposed yet.

CLOSED 2026-10-05: nodeCodeVerdict takes `nodeCreatedAt`; a node created on or after SIGNED_NODE_CODES_SINCE (the LIVE-688 merge, 2026-09-30T01:51:23Z) never had an unsigned code printed, so it gets no legacy path. verifyCapture reads `created_at` and passes it. Unit cases in lib/qr/node-code.test.ts pin both sides (a post-signing node refuses a bare id; a pre-signing node keeps its grace).

verify.note: Reads the verdict seam and its one caller. Fails on main before this change (mutation-checked by stashing the fix).

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-six adversarial read of the 2026-09-28..30 merges
